source: https://ollama.com/search?c=local 與各模型頁、tags 頁（名稱、介紹原文、參數、context、下載大小、更新月份、能力標籤），以及 Hugging Face GGUF；授權取自模型的 license 層或模型卡，無法取得時標示「請見模型頁」
source_en: https://ollama.com/search?c=local plus each model page and tags page (names, original descriptions, parameters, context, download sizes, update month, capability badges), and Hugging Face GGUF; licences come from the model's licence layer or model card, otherwise marked "See model page"
memory_note: 64GB 統一記憶體，macOS 預設約 48GB 可給 GPU；fit=ok 表示可與 embedding 等小模型同時載入，tight 需先卸載其他模型，no 放不下。大小為這台 Mac 的下載量：同一個 tag 同時有 GGUF 與 MLX 版時，Apple Silicon 會下載 MLX 版。
memory_note_en: 64GB unified memory; by default macOS lets the GPU use about 48GB. fit=ok means the model can be loaded alongside small models such as embeddings, tight means other models must be unloaded first, no means it does not fit. Sizes are the download on this Mac: when a tag has both GGUF and MLX builds, Apple silicon gets the MLX build.

other_category_notes.asr: 錄完再轉：把整段錄音或檔案轉成逐字稿（多半有時間軸），準確度優先。
other_category_notes.stream: 邊講邊出字：聲音一進來就吐出文字，延遲通常不到 1 秒，用在即時字幕、會議即時記錄、語音助理的耳朵。
other_category_notes.tts: 把文字念出來；有的只能用內建聲音，有的幾秒錄音就能複製聲音（須本人同意）。
other_category_notes.voice_chat: 一個模型直接聽語音、直接用語音回答（語音進、語音出），不用先轉文字再合成；全雙工的還能邊聽邊講、被打斷。
other_category_notes.speech_translate: 聽一種語言，輸出另一種語言的文字或語音；串流版可做同步口譯。
other_category_notes.vad: 只判斷「現在有沒有人在講話」，很小很快；即時字幕靠它切句，說話者分段與 ASR 靠它跳過靜音。
other_category_notes.diarize: 標出「誰在什麼時候說話」，再和逐字稿合併成「講者 1：…」。
other_category_notes.doc: 把 PDF、掃描檔、Office 文件轉成 Markdown，給 RAG 或 agent 讀。
other_category_notes.rerank: 把 RAG 檢索到的段落依相關程度重新排序，提高答案品質。

other_category_notes_en.asr: Transcribe after recording: turns a whole file into a transcript (usually with timestamps); accuracy first.
other_category_notes_en.stream: Text appears while the person is still speaking, usually within a second: live captions, live meeting notes, the ears of a voice assistant.
other_category_notes_en.tts: Reads text aloud; some have preset voices only, others clone a voice from a few seconds of audio (with the speaker's consent).
other_category_notes_en.voice_chat: One model hears speech and answers in speech (audio in, audio out) without a separate ASR and TTS step; full-duplex ones listen while talking and can be interrupted.
other_category_notes_en.speech_translate: Hears one language and outputs text or speech in another; streaming ones work as simultaneous interpreters.
other_category_notes_en.vad: Only decides whether someone is speaking right now; tiny and fast. Live captions use it to cut sentences, diarization and ASR use it to skip silence.
other_category_notes_en.diarize: Marks who spoke when, then merges with the transcript into "Speaker 1: …".
other_category_notes_en.doc: Turns PDFs, scans and Office files into Markdown for RAG or agents.
other_category_notes_en.rerank: Re-orders the passages RAG retrieved by relevance, for better answers.

cloud_models.note_en: Released July 2026; Azure docs say it is offline and not a Realtime API model, use gpt-realtime-whisper or gpt-live-transcribe for streaming (OpenAI's own API also allows Realtime transcription sessions); 25 MB max file; OpenAI list price USD 0.0045/min; no diarization; no language list published.

cloud_models.name: gpt-4o-transcribe
cloud_models.use: 以 GPT-4o 為基礎的語音轉文字：上傳音檔、回傳文字，可用 stream=true 邊轉邊回傳結果；不做說話者分離。
cloud_models.use_en: GPT-4o-based speech-to-text: upload an audio file and get text back, with optional stream=true for incremental output; no diarization.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2025-03-20（2025 年 3 月，Azure 標為 Preview）；單檔上限 25 MB；錯誤率比 whisper 低；OpenAI 定價約 US$0.006／分鐘；也可當 Realtime session 的輸入轉錄模型。
cloud_models.note_en: Version 2025-03-20 (March 2025, Preview on Azure); 25 MB max file; lower error rate than whisper; OpenAI list price about USD 0.006/min; can also serve as the input-transcription model in Realtime sessions.

cloud_models.name: gpt-4o-mini-transcribe
cloud_models.use: 以 GPT-4o mini 為基礎的平價語音轉文字：上傳音檔、回傳文字，支援 stream=true 漸進輸出；不做說話者分離。
cloud_models.use_en: Lower-cost GPT-4o mini speech-to-text: upload an audio file and get text back, with optional stream=true incremental output; no diarization.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2025-03-20 與 2025-12-15（後者提升準確度與穩定性，Azure 標為 Preview）；單檔上限 25 MB；OpenAI 定價約 US$0.003／分鐘，約為 gpt-4o-transcribe 的一半。
cloud_models.note_en: Versions 2025-03-20 and 2025-12-15 (the latter improves accuracy and robustness; Preview on Azure); 25 MB max file; OpenAI list price about USD 0.003/min, about half of gpt-4o-transcribe.

cloud_models.name: gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize
cloud_models.use: 語音轉文字並標出說話者：上傳音檔，回傳帶 speaker、起訖時間的分段；可附 2 到 10 秒的已知說話者樣本對應人名。
cloud_models.use_en: Speech-to-text with speaker labels: upload audio and get segments with speaker, start and end times; can take 2 to 10 second reference clips to map known speaker names.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2025-10-15（2025 年 10 月，Azure 標為 Preview）；單檔上限 25 MB；超過 30 秒須設 chunking_strategy；不支援 prompt、logprobs、timestamp_granularities；只能走 /audio/transcriptions，不支援 Realtime API。
cloud_models.note_en: Version 2025-10-15 (October 2025, Preview on Azure); 25 MB max file; chunking_strategy required for audio over 30 s; no prompt, logprobs or timestamp_granularities; /audio/transcriptions only, not the Realtime API.

cloud_models.name: gpt-realtime-whisper
cloud_models.use: 即時串流轉錄：邊收音邊回傳逐字稿增量，可調整延遲與準確度的取捨，適合即時字幕與會議記錄；只輸出文字。
cloud_models.use_en: Live streaming transcription: returns transcript deltas while audio is still arriving, with a tunable latency/accuracy trade-off, for live captions and meeting notes; text output only.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2026-05-06（2026 年 5 月與 gpt-realtime-2 同批發表）；依音訊時長計費，OpenAI 定價 US$0.017／分鐘；不是 /audio API 模型；可給 ISO-639-1 語言提示；未列語言清單。
cloud_models.note_en: Version 2026-05-06 (May 2026, launched with gpt-realtime-2); billed by audio duration, OpenAI list price USD 0.017/min; not an /audio API model; accepts ISO-639-1 language hints; no language list published.

cloud_models.name: gpt-live-transcribe
cloud_models.use: 低延遲即時串流轉錄：邊收音邊回傳逐字稿增量，延遲可調，可給多個語言提示；只輸出文字。
cloud_models.use_en: Low-latency live streaming transcription: returns transcript deltas from live audio, tunable latency, accepts multiple language hints; text output only.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2026-07-29（2026 年 7 月與 gpt-transcribe 同時發表）；Azure 標示為目前即時轉錄的推薦模型，錯誤率低於 gpt-realtime-whisper；依時長計費，OpenAI 定價 US$0.017／分鐘；未列語言清單。
cloud_models.note_en: Version 2026-07-29 (July 2026, released alongside gpt-transcribe); Azure lists it as the current recommended realtime transcription model, lower error rate than gpt-realtime-whisper; billed by duration, OpenAI list price USD 0.017/min; no language list published.

cloud_models.name: gpt-live-1
cloud_models.api: GPT-Live API（WebSocket／WebRTC；OpenAI 端為 v1/live/sessions，不是 /realtime）
cloud_models.api_en: GPT-Live API (WebSocket/WebRTC; v1/live/sessions on OpenAI, not /realtime)
cloud_models.use: 全雙工語音對話：可同時聽與說、能被自然打斷，把搜尋、工具與深度推理委派給後端模型；輸出語音，也可做語音翻譯。
cloud_models.use_en: Full-duplex voice conversation: listens and speaks at the same time, handles natural interruptions, and delegates search, tools and deeper reasoning to a backend model; speech output, also usable for speech translation.
cloud_models.note: OpenAI 2026 年 7 月發表（ChatGPT 語音），Azure 為公開預覽；語音 session 依時長計費（OpenAI 定價 US$0.05／分鐘，Azure 部落格寫每小時 US$3），後端模型另計；WebRTC 每 session 最少計 15 秒；支援多語，但品質不保證與 gpt-realtime 相同。
cloud_models.note_en: OpenAI released it in July 2026 (ChatGPT voice); public preview on Azure; voice session billed by duration (OpenAI list USD 0.05/min, Azure blog USD 3/hour) with backend model billed separately; WebRTC sessions have a 15 s billing minimum; multilingual, quality not guaranteed to match gpt-realtime.

cloud_models.name: gpt-realtime-translate
cloud_models.use: 即時語音翻譯：持續串流輸入語音，自動偵測來源語言，同步輸出目標語言的語音與文字逐字稿。
cloud_models.use_en: Live speech translation: streams input speech continuously, auto-detects the source language, and outputs translated speech plus a translated text transcript.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2026-05-06（2026 年 5 月）；OpenAI 宣稱支援 70 種以上輸入語言、13 種輸出語言（Azure 未列清單）；依時長計費，OpenAI 定價 US$0.034／分鐘；不支援自訂 prompt 與選擇聲音；要原文字幕需搭配轉錄模型。
cloud_models.note_en: Version 2026-05-06 (May 2026); OpenAI claims 70+ input and 13 output languages (Azure publishes no list); billed by duration, OpenAI list price USD 0.034/min; no custom prompt or voice selection; pair with a transcription model for source-language captions.

cloud_models.name: gpt-4o-mini-tts
cloud_models.use: 文字轉語音：輸入文字、輸出語音檔，可用指示控制語氣與風格；可串流播放音訊。
cloud_models.use_en: Text-to-speech: text in, audio out, with instructions to steer tone and speaking style; audio can be streamed for playback.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2025-03-20 與 2025-12-15；Azure 列在「文字轉語音（預覽）」表；同表另有 tts、tts-hd。
cloud_models.note_en: Versions 2025-03-20 and 2025-12-15; listed in Azure's text-to-speech (preview) table, alongside tts and tts-hd.

cloud_models.name: gpt-realtime
cloud_models.use: 語音對語音助理：一個模型聽語音、推理、呼叫工具並以語音回答，採輪流發言；也可輸入圖片。
cloud_models.use_en: Speech-to-speech assistant: one model hears speech, reasons, calls tools and answers in speech, turn-based; also accepts image input.
cloud_models.note: 版本 2025-08-28（2025 年 8 月 GA）；依 token 計費（OpenAI 定價音訊輸入 US$32／百萬 token）；輸入上限 32,000、輸出 4,096 token；單一 session 最長 60 分鐘；後續版本有 gpt-realtime-mini、1.5、2、2.1。
cloud_models.note_en: Version 2025-08-28 (GA, August 2025); token-based billing (OpenAI list USD 32 per 1M audio input tokens); 32,000 input and 4,096 output tokens; 60-minute max session; later versions include gpt-realtime-mini, 1.5, 2 and 2.1.
